en.html:
Let Hikaru die?

...The answer was clear enough. I could not save her because there was no way to save her. None was there.

Two years ago—or perhaps even before that—my fate had been fixed in the stars. The duty I had to carry out, that path too was decided. This ending was settled long ago.

I knew it. This much I knew.

So these useless questions to myself—surely it was that fate itself I was questioning.

さよ「……お辛いのですね」
景明「辛い？」
ja.text: 景明「なぜ」さよ「……お辛いのですね」景明「辛い？」

en.html:
At this unexpected word, I tilted my head. However I turned it over in my slow, heavy thoughts, why she would say such a thing I could not understand.

I was suffering?
...That could not be.

Kageaki Minato was not hurt. The ones hurt, the ones whose lives were taken, were always other people. Never me.

Those who had fought and been cut down because I insisted on having my own way.
Those who had been cut down merely for being good, merely for being near me.

The suffering was theirs.

Kageaki Minato was not suffering.

ja.html:
突拍子もない言葉に、俺は首を傾げた。
　重く鈍い思考をどう巡らせてみても、どうしてその
ような事を言われたのか理解できない。

　俺が辛い？
　……そんな筈はなかった。

　湊斗景明は傷ついていないのだから。
　傷つき、生命を奪われるのは、常に俺以外の人間だ。

　俺が我意を通した為に、戦い斬られた人々。
　ただ善良であり、ただ俺の近くにいたが為に、斬ら
れた人々。

　辛かったのは彼らだ。

　湊斗景明は辛くなどない。
